title: Dinah and Shechem
description: Dinah, Jacob's daughter, is violated by Shechem, the son of the Hivite Hamor. Shechem wants to marry her, and her brothers respond with deceit, demanding that all the men in the city be circumcised as a condition for marriage. On the third day, while the men are still in pain, Simeon and Levi enter the city, kill all the men—including Hamor and Shechem—and bring Dinah back. Jacob's sons plunder the city, and Jacob rebukes Simeon and Levi for making him detestable in the land.
